verdict.rationale: Oyster's API documents creating a draft EOR employment, updating job details, and submitting it to start onboarding and contract generation. Country-specific rulesets, agreement verification and signature, benefits provisioning, client-credentials auth and developer sandboxes round this out, and an llms.txt eases agent consumption. However, compensation setup is only implied: bonuses and allowances are documented as retrieval only, with no explicit salary-setting endpoint. Tax setup through the API is not evidenced at all. Missing for 10: explicit compensation/salary write endpoints, tax setup via API, end-to-end agent workflow documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.
